max_tire.note: One owner ran 30x9.50 BFGoodrich all-terrains on a stock '93 and said they came close to rubbing but didn't (Off-Road.com forum)
Rough Country and Zone rate their spacer lifts for 30x9.50s; one Quadratec reviewer fit 31x10.50R15s on the Zone 2 in kit after trimming the front bumper
Rough Country's 3.5 in kit, with transfer-case drop and fixed lower arms, is rated for 31x10.50s

items.title: Fuel tank leak risk in rear impacts
items.summary: About 1.56 million ZJs and 2002–07 Libertys; dealers inspected the rear structure and fitted a Chrysler-designed tow hitch.

items.title: Shifter can rest out of Park
items.summary: If not fully in Park the vehicle could roll backward; dealers added a secondary detent to the floor shifter.

items.title: Front axle overheating on the temporary spare
items.summary: Quadra-Trac trucks on 225/70R16, 225/75R16 or 245/70R15 tires; dealers replaced the space-saver with a full-size spare.

items.title: Front lower control arm cam bolts
items.summary: Eccentric cam adjuster bolts at the front lower arm-to-axle brackets could fail due to assembly misalignment.

items.title: Liftgate latch bumpers swell
items.summary: Assembly grease swelled the latch bumpers, so the liftgate might not latch or might be hard to open.

items.title: Steering column shaft pin
items.summary: A sheared plastic pin could let the upper and lower steering shafts separate.

items.title: Inadvertent airbag deployment
items.summary: The circuit design could allow an airbag to deploy when the ignition was switched off.

items.title: Brake booster vacuum reservoir diaphragm
items.summary: The vacuum reservoir diaphragm could split or tear.

timeline.change: Revealed at the January Detroit show; 1993-model trucks on sale in April with the 4.0 six only
5.2 Magnum V8, Quadra-Trac (NV249) and the one-year woodgrain Grand Wagoneer arrive early in the year; AW4 replaced by the 42RE mid-year
Base model renamed SE; Infinity Gold audio; Grand Wagoneer dropped; last year of the AX15 manual in North America
Orvis Edition (10,020 built); SE gains standard power windows, ABS and A/C
Facelift and new interior with dual airbags, OBD-II, revised NV249 with a true 50/50 low range; Command-Trac and SE dropped; 4.0 rerated to 185 hp
TSi and Laredo Special Edition; 5.2 V8 available with 2WD; last Orvis year
One-year 5.9 Limited (245 hp, 14,286 built); production ends mid-1998 as the WJ takes over

identify.intro: The ZJ came with three transfer cases, three rear axles and several special editions, so identify what's actually under the truck before you pay a premium.

items.head: 5.9 Limited
items.body: 1998 only. Look for working hood louvers, a mesh grille, unique five-spoke 16 in wheels, unique rocker moldings, a chrome exhaust tip and a 46RE with 3.73 gears and a rear Trac-Lok. US colors were Deep Slate, Stone White and Bright Platinum only.

items.head: 1993–95 vs 1996–98
items.body: 1996-on trucks have new bumpers and side cladding, a larger grille, a passenger airbag, an OBD-II port under the dash, a three-spoke wheel with cruise buttons, and raised metal 4x4 badges instead of decals.

items.head: Transfer case
items.body: Command-Trac (NP231, part-time, 1993–95), Selec-Trac (NP242, part-time or full-time) or Quadra-Trac (NV249, full-time). All three use a lever beside the gear selector; read the tag on the case to be sure.

items.head: Rear axle
items.body: Dana 35, Dana 44 or Chrysler 8.25 depending on year, engine and package. Read the tag on the cover or housing before buying gears, lockers or shafts.

items.head: Grand Wagoneer (1993)
items.body: A Limited with standard 5.2 V8 and Quadra-Trac, woodgrain vinyl on the fenders, doors and tailgate, chrome Grand Wagoneer badges, no lower cladding and a beige interior; 6,378 built.

items.head: Orvis and Up Country
items.body: Orvis Limiteds (1995–97) are Moss Green (or Light Driftwood in 1997) with roan red accents and green-and-tan leather. The Up Country package (1993–97) has taller springs, longer bump stops and heavier German gas shocks mounted upside down, for about 1 in more height.

capability.note: 5.2 V8 at launch and 4.0 by 1995, per Wikipedia

capability.v: 8.3 s (5.2, Motor Trend 1995) · 6.8 s (5.9 Limited, Motor Trend 1998)

values.intro: Prices are flat and low. Only very low-mileage originals, V8 Limiteds and the 5.9 Limited sell for more than an ordinary used SUV.
values.note: Based on 19 Bring a Trailer sales from October 2025 to October 2026 (median about $9,700, middle half $7,000–12,250). The top result was an 11,000-mile 1998 Limited at $18,500. 5.9 Limiteds have sold on BaT for $6,500–25,500 since 2019, most recently $9,750 in March 2026.
